# regen: health, vigor, interval milliseconds (out of combat only)
# npc: entity, health, damage, attack ms, range, respawn ms, XP, gold

# Explicit verified group roster: spawn-group<TAB>group hex id<TAB>capacity<TAB>child hex ids separated by commas.
